proposed.sourceName: American Halal Foundation (AHF) — AHF Halal Standard (HCS-001)
proposed.paraphrase: AHF's HCS-001 standard requires manual slaughter by a practicing Muslim with Tasmiyah/Takbir on each animal, only reversible stunning (animal alive at slaughter), and prohibits pork, blood and khamr (≥1% ethanol) — comfortably meeting the mainstream general-halal baseline.

researcherNote: FLAG: AHF's published HCS-001 (2024-11-28) actually requires MANUAL slaughter (machine non-conforming) + reversible-stun-only + Tasmiyah on each — STRICTER than the app's draft rationale ('mainstream US; accept mechanical slaughter'). The general/lenient claims remain true (AHF satisfies them and more); the draft could later PROMOTE AHF toward hanafiStrict. Flagged for owner — not cited beyond the model's confidentlySatisfies set.
